about: The v5.2.0 release gate rows that replace the ledger rows (owner rulings 41 and 81; rebuild/DESIGN-GENERAL-RECORDS.md, RB-R1 release gates; lane RB-REC7). RB-R1 runs each row on the candidate and pastes its evidence. A bench row counts only when its leg ran and passed: a leg that cannot run fails with BLOCKED, never skips. check_v520_gate.py keeps this list whole: every row named below, every path it names present, no removed gate back.

rows.what: file-tool first call succeeds, 95% lower bound at least 95% per head per family, claude-haiku-5-5 included
rows.measure: tests/evals/behaviour (RB-REC6's arms on the file tools)

rows.what: totals correct at least 98% (95% lower bound) per head per family
0 stray or duplicate lines in the families; the doubled-append arm X turns them red
rows.measure: python3 tests/evals/families/run_families.py run --arms A,B,X ... then table

rows.what: refloop totals 9 of 9 (3 heads x 3 repetitions) on every family's day scenario: meal-log-day, expense-day, training-week
green parity on claude-sonnet-5-5 and claude-haiku-5-5 for food, expenses and training: the harness's check rate at least the reference loop's less 5 points
the owner-regression battery with its food family on file lines and its expense and training families (lc-exp-*, lc-trn-*), every row at its threshold on the gate models
the file replay: every owner-shaped and three-domain case passes on the candidate

rows.measure: the parity runner and the truth probe's corpus (rulings 9, 33)

rows.what: a hedge rate no worse than the RB-M0a control
at least 48,000 B free on esp32s3-cyd (ruling 39)
a cut during files.append leaves the old file, the whole append or a torn tail that the next read names and the next append fences
a cut during files.edit leaves the old or the new file, never a mix
a round trip with one row added: one line more, every other byte as it was

candidate, v5.1.1 and v5.1.2, candidate: sha8 unchanged with no writes; the old image's append leaves engine-2 rows byte-identical (its keyed merge of one date and key is the recorded limit, ruling 42 item 7)
one append and one edit under a refusing allocator: no file change, an honest reply
rows.measure: pytest tests/hil/test_files_bench.py -m hil --allow-hardware -k refused (needs the ALLOCREFUSE console verb)

rows.what: owner ruling 81: every head's default history max, fold mark and keep are at least v5.1.2's; no default carries less conversation
rows.measure: RB-BG's property test test/test_request_budget::test_no_head_below_its_v5_1_2_budget in the candidate's native run
